svg.title: RAG system architecture diagram
svg.desc: Full RAG architecture showing the offline indexing pipeline on top and the online query pipeline below, both sharing a central vector database. Arrows trace the exact data flow from raw documents to a final LLM-generated answer.
svg.text: Offline — indexing pipeline (runs once, on ingestion)

sendPrompt('How does semantic search work in a vector database?')
sendPrompt('How is the augmented prompt structured in RAG?')
